quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung press release: Samsung Electronics To Establish HVAC Production Line in (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Samsung will invest approximately KRW 240 billion (USD 158 million) to build a 21,500 m2 FläktGroup HVAC production line at its Gwangju, Korea site, scheduled to begin operations upon completion by 2028. It will make FläktGroup HVAC products, including advanced cooling solutions for AI data centers, with emphasis on the surge in AI data center demand in Korea. It becomes FläktGroup's 15th manufacturing facility (14 today, supplying the US, Europe and India; a new Pune, India facility under Project GAGAN will operate soon). Samsung DA head EVP Cheolgi Kim: the HVAC business is to become a new growth engine, aiming to be a global top-tier company by 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: KRW 240 billion (USD 158 million) Gwangju HVAC line, 21,500 m2, operations by 2028; 15th FläktGroup plant
